Name: PoseToAttr
Description: Will save current pose to an attr via SDK

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Will save current pose to an attr via SDK. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetObject: set the node/object name this block should use. NewAttrName: set the node/object name this block should use. SetNewAttrNode: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. AnimStep: set the node/object name this block should use. Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
